ad_info.structure_source: library format F54 (Lista de preguntas de síntomas con la marca como respuesta, fondo oscuro), structure mv-24
ad_info.reference_style: Dark text-card ad: a right-aligned column of short everyday situations, each answered with the brand name in bold

global_identity.color_palette: Lemon yellow #F5E13A (label color, highlighted words, the 'Pagas al recibir' badge), amber brown #9A4F12 (glass and warm accents), deep cocoa #2B1A10 (dark background), warm cream #FFF6DC, white #FFFFFF (text on dark), gold #C9962B (thin lines and card borders), offer red #D62828 used ONLY for the offer pill 'Tratamiento completo: 3 frascos para 3 meses'.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bold direct-response health ad built around the real amber dropper bottle with its yellow label; the same bottle, the same palette, the same red offer pill and the same bordered yellow 'Pagas al recibir' badge in every image.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Calm, honest, a little ironic: a deep cocoa background like the reference, warm daylight inside the photo card.
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat dark background, one rounded photo card with a thin gold border, a small inset card, a right-aligned text column, one red offer pill and one bordered yellow badge; no logos.
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins ExtraBold uppercase for the headline (white #FFFFFF with the word 'JEAN' in lemon yellow #F5E13A); Montserrat or Poppins Regular white for the situations; Poppins Bold lemon yellow for each 'VitalDrops' answer.

creative_objective: Make the woman who eats and does not gain recognize her everyday frustrations line by line, each one answered with 'VitalDrops', while a real photo shows the loose-jeans moment next to a small result inset; close with the fixed offer and 'Pagas al recibir'.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Headline at the top; 2) the right-aligned list with the repeated yellow 'VitalDrops'; 3) the photo card of the loose-jeans moment with its result inset and the small bottle; 4) the bottom offer and trust block.
art_direction.composition_style: Same as reference mv-24: a flat dark background with a column of short lines aligned to the right, each line ending in the brand name in bold, filling the center of the canvas. Added to the left (mandatory in this app): a tall photo card with the 'before' scene and a small result inset.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top 15 % headline, middle 71 % (left 38 % photo card, right 58 % text column with even line spacing), bottom 14 % offer block. Margins about 4 % on all sides.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat matte cocoa background with a very faint warm vignette; inside the photo card, soft window daylight from the left; the bottle with a soft contact shadow.

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Reference: flat very dark brown background; centered-right column of nine short questions in white regular sans-serif, each followed on the same line by the brand name in bold white; a small logo centered at the bottom; nothing else. Adaptation: the questions become short affirmative situations, the brand answer is 'VitalDrops' in bold lemon yellow, a headline is added at the top, a tall photo card with the before scene and a result inset is added on the left, the bottom logo is replaced by the offer and trust block.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 text-card ad on a flat matte deep cocoa #2B1A10 background with a very faint warm vignette, like a dark chocolate card. TOP ZONE (3-14 % of height): centered headline in Poppins ExtraBold uppercase, white #FFFFFF, about 7 % of the canvas height, one line or two balanced lines: 'TU RITUAL PARA LLENAR EL JEAN', with only the word 'JEAN' in lemon yellow #F5E13A. MIDDLE ZONE (17-85 % of height): LEFT 38 % of the width: one tall rounded photo card (corner radius 16 px, 2 px gold #C9962B border) filling 17-85 % of the height, a realistic smartphone photo of a real young Colombian woman, about 26, light-brown skin with visible pores and a few freckles, dark-brown hair in a loose low ponytail with flyaway strands, no studio makeup, plain white cotton T-shirt with real wrinkles and light-blue jeans one size too big, standing sideways to the camera in a simple bedroom with soft warm window light from the left, camera at hip height from the side, framed from the head to the knees, her face turned to the lens with a frustrated, tired half-frown; with one hand she pulls the back of the jeans waistband a full fist away from her lower back so the empty gap between denim and body is clearly visible, a baggy fold of extra denim below the seat, drooping back pockets, one straight flat vertical line from waist to thigh, thin straight thighs with loose fabric: flat, no curve, no volume. In the upper right corner of this card, a small inset card (about 32 % of the card width, white 3 px border, rounded 10 px): the same woman (same face, hair, skin) on another day, standing three-quarter facing the camera, smiling, in a lemon-yellow knit top and dark-blue jeans that fit snugly on hips and thighs with no loose fabric, a curvier hourglass silhouette with hips clearly wider than her waist, framed from the head to mid-thigh, never from behind. At the bottom right corner of the photo card, overlapping its edge, the product standing upright at about 20 % of the canvas height: ONE amber-brown glass Boston-round dropper bottle exactly as in the attached product photo, about 2.6 times taller than wide, ribbed matte black collar, tall matte black dropper bulb, lemon-yellow-to-white label facing the camera and legible ('amua', 'VITALDROPS'), matte, no rainbow, soft shadow. RIGHT 58 % of the width: a column of seven lines aligned to the right, evenly spaced from 19 % to 82 % of the height, each line about 4 % of the canvas height: a short situation in white Poppins Regular, then a wide gap, then the word 'VitalDrops' in Poppins Bold lemon yellow #F5E13A, all the 'VitalDrops' words stacked in one aligned column at the right edge. The seven situations, top to bottom: 'Jean que queda bailando atrás', 'Comer de todo y no subir', 'Llenarse con dos bocados', 'Pasar el día sin hambre', 'Sin pila para entrenar', 'Gomitas que no hicieron nada', 'Miedo al quirófano'. BOTTOM ZONE (86-100 % of height): a thin 2 px gold line, then centered side by side: a red #D62828 rounded pill with white Poppins ExtraBold text 'Tratamiento completo: 3 frascos para 3 meses', and a lemon-yellow #F5E13A rounded badge with a 3 px white border, a small hand-and-box line icon and 'Pagas al recibir' in deep cocoa Poppins ExtraBold. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it.
